auditor_value: (a) car frame: pseudo-force −10 N along î gives a_rel = −5 î with v_rel(0) = 10 k̂, so x_rel = −2.5t², z_rel = 10t, a parabola x_rel = −z_rel²/40 curving toward the back of the car; (b) ground frame: no horizontal force, straight line at constant 10 m/s along k̂
notes: Every equation follows: x_rel = −½(5)t², z_rel = 10t, x_rel = −½(5)(z_rel/10)² = −z_rel²/40. Because the car starts from rest, the object's 10 m/s sideways speed is the same in both frames at t = 0, which the solution uses correctly. Both common_mistakes entries are genuine. The 2 kg mass and g = 10 are not needed (frictionless floor); the solution does not misuse them.
